name: Calendly
description: Calendly bookings become events: Meeting Scheduled when someone books, Meeting Cancelled when they cancel or reschedule. Use them for reminders and follow-ups that skip cancelled meetings.

signature_secret.label: Calendly webhook signing key
signature_secret.help: The signing_key you choose when creating the webhook subscription. Calendly signs each webhook with it.

setup: Create the integration from this recipe and copy its webhook URL.
Pick a long random signing key and save it as the integration's signing secret.

Create a webhook subscription with Calendly's API (a Standard plan or higher is needed): POST https://api.calendly.com/webhook_subscriptions with your personal access token and {"url": "<webhook URL>", "events": ["invitee.created", "invitee.canceled"], "organization": "<your organization URI>", "scope": "organization", "signing_key": "<the same key>"}. GET https://api.calendly.com/users/me shows your organization URI.
Book a test meeting and check the delivery log.
Review the draft reminder and follow-up flows and turn them on.

flows.name: Calendly: meeting reminder
flows.description: The day before a meeting at 9am, reminds the invitee with the cancel and reschedule links. Skipped if the meeting was cancelled or moved. A service message about their own meeting.

content.subject: Reminder: {{ event.properties.event_name|default('your meeting') }} tomorrow
content.preheader: Need to change it? Reschedule in one click

blocks.html:
Your {{ event.properties.event_name|default('meeting') }} starts {{ event.properties.start_time }}.

Where: {{ event.properties.location|default('see your calendar invite') }}

flows.name: Calendly: follow-up
flows.description: The day after a meeting at 10am, thanks the invitee. Skipped if the meeting was cancelled.

blocks.html: It was good to talk. Reply to this email with any questions, or book another time whenever you like.
